name: Haldor Brassbeard
acBreakdown: 10 + 4 (Scale Mail, Medium) + 1 (Dex, Medium max +2) + 1 (Shield, Medium Steel) = 16

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.notes: Slashing. Versatile (1d10+3 in two hands, without the shield). Advantage on your first attack with it each round (Weapon Specialisation; its +1 damage is included). His clan weapon.

weapons.name: Javelin
weapons.notes: Piercing. Thrown with Strength. Disadvantage if an enemy is within 5ft of you. All 3 share 1 slot.

armour.name: Scale Mail
armour.notes: Bronze scales. Noisy: Disadvantage on checks to move quietly or hide

personality: A broad, red-bearded dwarf of Tenor Hold in bronze scale, round shield up and sword ready, who treats every tunnel as if it owes him money. Gruff, proud and steady as a forge-stone; he hums mining songs when nervous and polishes his shield when bored. The Broken Anvil is a Tenor forge mine, dug by his own people, and he will not hear of goblins keeping it.
inAFight: Hold the front with your shield up, so arrows struggle to reach you or the friend beside you, and hit the nearest goblin with your longsword (Advantage on the first swing each round). Trip or Intimidating Strike anything big.
abilitiesText:
**Weapon Specialisation (Longsword).** Advantage on the first attack roll you make with your longsword each round, and +1 damage with it (included).

**Combat Reflexes.** Once per round, make one melee Attack of Opportunity against an enemy you can see that leaves your reach or moves past or through it. Disengage prevents it.

**Combat Manoeuvres.** Each replaces one attack: Trip, Disarm, Grapple, Dirty Trick, Push, Cleave and Shield Blow (see Combat Manoeuvres). Your manoeuvre save DC is 13.

**Intimidating Strike (Fighter manoeuvre).** On a hit, the target makes a Will save (DC 13) or is Frightened until the end of its next turn.

**Shield Wall (kit).** Ranged attacks against you and an ally next to you have Disadvantage.

**Dwarf-Friend (kit).** Advantage on dwarven clan etiquette and weapon identification checks. Dul Khagul dwarves trust you on sight; he learned the shield-wall from them.

**Dwarf (Tenor Hold).** Speed 25ft, never reduced by armour or load. Darkvision 60ft. Advantage on stonework and underground construction checks, and on saves against poison (Resistance 5 to poison). Tenor Hold: Advantage to craft, repair or identify firearms and mechanical devices, and on checks about human cultures and languages.

**Stonebraced.** Once per day, treat a critical hit against you as a normal hit, or ignore a knockdown.

**Craft: Blacksmithing.** Advantage on Blacksmithing checks (the Dwarf's free craft, not an NWP slot).

**The Clan Weapon.** His longsword is the Brassbeard blade. If he loses it, he has Disadvantage on Charisma checks with other dwarves until it is back.

**Toughness (1st, General).** +1 Max HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included), and Advantage on Constitution checks.
hook: This is his people's mine, and he wants it back before the forges go cold for good.

name: Wick Tallow

weapons.name: Short Sword
weapons.notes: Piercing. Finesse, Light. Sneak Attack +2d6, or Back Attack for 2d6+4 (not both).

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.notes: Piercing. Finesse, Light, Concealable, Thrown. You carry 2, 1 slot each.

weapons.name: Sling
weapons.notes: Bludgeoning. Sneak Attack works within 30ft. Disadvantage if an enemy is within 5ft of you.

personality: A hooded lock-picker in a dark cloak; nobody in the Keepers has seen their face, and Wick likes it that way. Quiet, wry and unhurried, they answer questions with questions and pocket anything shiny out of habit, then give most of it back. Trained by the Guild, lent to the Keepers, and paid by the lock.
inAFight: Roll Initiative with Advantage, then stab or shoot a goblin that has not acted yet for Sneak Attack (Advantage, +2d6). Later, slip behind a busy goblin for a Back Attack.
abilitiesText:
**Sneak Attack.** Once per round, against an aware but unsuspecting target within 30ft: Advantage on the attack and +2d6 damage (1d6, +1d6 from Predator). Unsuspecting means it cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is in melee with an ally and not with you. No stealth check needed. It cannot combine with Back Attack.

**Back Attack.** Once per round, after a successful Hide or Move Silently check, attack a target from behind with a melee weapon shorter than your arm: Advantage, and double the weapon's damage dice (short sword 2d6+4).

**Precise Strikes.** +1 damage on every weapon hit (included).

**Hide and Move Silently.** Normal roll at half speed or less, Disadvantage above it, impossible while running or charging. You count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on a result of 12 to 14. Listening through a solid barrier has Disadvantage.

**Rogue Skills.** Climb (Dex), Open Locks (Dex; one try per lock until you gain a level), Pick Pocket (Dex; DC 10 + the target's Level), Find/Disable/Set Trap (Int) and Decipher Script (Int). You know Cant. Your Lockpicks give Advantage on checks to pick locks.

**Guild Contract (kit).** When your Sneak Attack hits, the next ally to attack that target before your next turn has Advantage. Advantage on Pick Pocket and Open Locks on a Guild-assigned contract.

**Guild Signal (kit).** Advantage on checks to identify Guild members by their signals and methods, and to gather information for a Crow or Raven.

**Human.** Speed 30ft, no darkvision. Knack: Climb, with Advantage on Climb checks (not an NWP slot).

**Predator (1st, Specialist).** Advantage on Stealth checks, and your Sneak Attack deals +1d6 (included).

**Swift Reflexes (1st, General, Human bonus feat).** +1 Dexterity, moved to Wisdom by the starting cap (included). Advantage on Initiative rolls.
hook: Wick has bet the quartermaster a silver piece per lock that they can open every one in the mine.

name: Fenna Thornmantle

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.notes: Bludgeoning; 1d8 in two hands (Versatile). Oak, no metal. Her spellcasting focus.

weapons.name: Sling
weapons.notes: Bludgeoning. Leather and river stones. Disadvantage if an enemy is within 5ft of you.

spells.notes:
First Aid (cantrip): touch, a dying creature is stabilised at its current HP with no roll; it stays unconscious until healed or for 1 hour.
Thorn Whip (cantrip): 30ft, one creature takes 1d4 piercing and is pulled 10ft towards you; Reflex negates both.
Poison Spray (cantrip): 10ft, one creature takes 1d6 poison; Fortitude negates.
Cure Light Wounds (1st): touch, heals 1d8+3 (+1 for level, +1 Forest Vigour, +1 Healer); one free cast a day from Healer.
Faerie Fire (1st): 60ft, 20ft radius, 1 minute; creatures are outlined, lose Invisible and concealment, and attacks against them have Advantage; Reflex negates.
Thunderwave (1st): 15ft cone, 1d6 thunder and pushed 10ft; Fortitude halves the damage and stops the push. Heard 300ft away.

personality: A red-haired wood elf in a crown of antlers and leaves, never far from Bramble, the bad-tempered boar who adopted her. Warm, blunt and fiercely protective; she patches up anyone who stands still long enough, then tells them off for getting hurt. She trained with the Nalwood circle, and joined the Keepers because hurt people rarely come to the forest.
inAFight: Keep everyone standing with Cure Light Wounds and First Aid. Open with Faerie Fire on a crowd so the others hit with Advantage, Thunderwave anything that gets too close, and let Bramble charge.
abilitiesText:
**Spell Use.** Nature caster, Wisdom-based, save DC 13. Three cantrips at will. Two 1st-level slots a day (1, +1 for Wisdom 13+), back after a long rest. Each morning prepare three spells (level 1 + Wisdom +2) from the whole Druid list. Her oak staff is her focus.

**Wild Shape.** Once a day, become a beast of Level 1 or lower (a boar like Bramble) for up to an hour, using its whole stat block. You keep your mind and cannot cast in a form that cannot speak; when the form drops to 0 HP you return with the HP you had.

**Nature Lore (Wisdom).** In your home region, identify plants and animals perfectly, tell whether water is safe, and find shelter and food for one person; elsewhere it needs a Wisdom check.

**Bonus Language.** You speak Druidic, the circle's secret tongue.

**Forest Vigour (kit).** Healing you cast restores +1 HP per die.

**Ancient Lore (kit).** Advantage on Nature Lore checks in old-growth forest.

**Healer (1st, Arcane & Devout).** Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die, and once a day you cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without a slot.

**Bramble.** A wild boar she befriended with Animal Friendship. She renews it each evening before she rests, so it costs no slot on the day; harm him and the friendship ends. He follows her and the GM runs him: Level 1, AC 16, 9 HP, speed 40ft, Tusk +4 (1d8+2), Charge (+1d8 and Fortitude DC 12 or Prone after a 20ft straight run), Relentless once a day.

**Elf (Saevren).** Speed 35ft, low-light vision. Immune to magical sleep. Advantage on saves against charm, on concentration saves, and on Perception by sight or hearing; Advantage on Stealth and Perception in natural surroundings. Trance: 4 hours' rest instead of 8.

**Camouflage.** Once a day, as part of your movement in natural terrain, become undetectable to passive notice until you move or act.

**No forged metal.** Her weapons and armour are wood, leather and stone, as a druid's must be.
hook: If anyone down there is hurt, goblin or not, she means to bring them out.

name: Ilvaeth Duskwhisper
kit: The Queen of Air and Darkness
acBreakdown: 10 + 2 (Dex); no armour or shield (Warlocks are trained in none, and wearing any blocks casting) = 12
classFeatures: Dark Gift (The Queen of Air and Darkness)

weapons.name: Staff
weapons.notes: Bludgeoning; 1d8 in two hands (Versatile). Black wood. Her spellcasting focus.

spells.notes:
Eldritch Blast (cantrip): 60ft, one creature, Reflex DC 13; 1d6+2 force on a failure (Cantrip Mastery), half of 1d6 on a success.
Daze (cantrip, Cantrip Mastery): 60ft, one humanoid of Level 4 or lower is Stunned for 1 round; Will negates, and it is then immune to your Daze for the encounter.
Mage Hand (cantrip, Cantrip Mastery): 30ft, 1 minute; an invisible hand moves an unattended object of up to 5 lb at 15ft a round.
Faerie Fire (1st, Path spell): 60ft, 20ft radius, 1 minute; creatures are outlined, lose Invisible and concealment, and attacks against them have Advantage; Reflex negates.
Sleep (1st): 90ft, 15ft radius; 2d4+1 Levels of creatures fall Unconscious for 1d4 minutes, lowest Level first; Will negates, damage wakes them, and Level 5+, undead and constructs are unaffected.

personality: A white-haired Nu'Dravi who struck a bargain with the Queen of Air and Darkness, and throws purple eldritch force like she was born to it. Poised, sardonic and hard to read; she is comfortable in the dark in ways that make the others uneasy. The Keepers ask fewer questions than anyone else, which suits her perfectly.
inAFight: Hang back and Eldritch Blast every turn (Reflex DC 13; 1d6+2 on a failure). Daze the goblin who matters, drop Sleep on a pack before it reaches you, and Fey Step out of reach.
abilitiesText:
**Eldritch Blast.** At will, 60ft, one creature: Reflex save DC 13. On a failure 1d6+2 force (+2 from Cantrip Mastery); on a success half of 1d6. Never uses a slot.

**Spell Use.** Arcane caster, Charisma-based, save DC 13. Two 1st-level slots a day (1, +1 for Charisma 13+), back after a long rest. You know Faerie Fire (Path spell) and Sleep. No spell attack rolls: harmful spells call for a save. Any armour or shield blocks your casting. Her staff is her focus.

**Fey Step (Path of the Fey).** Once per round, teleport up to 10ft to an unoccupied space you can see as part of your movement.

**Dark Gift (The Queen of Air and Darkness).** Darkness you create is impenetrable to all sight, darkvision included. You see perfectly in any darkness, magical or mundane.

**Pact.** A Warlock holds the patron's alignment, so her Allegiance is the Queen's (Chaotic Evil), whatever her Outlook.

**Nu'Dravi.** Speed 30ft, darkvision 120ft. Immune to magical sleep. Advantage on saves against charm, and on Perception by sight or hearing in low light or darkness. Trance: 4 hours' rest.

**Innate magic.** Dancing Lights at will. Once a day, Darkness (20ft radius, 1 round at her level) or Faerie Fire (Reflex save, DC 13).

**Sunlight.** She follows no faith: Disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception for the first hour of direct sunlight each day.

**Cantrip Mastery (1st, Arcane & Devout).** Two extra cantrips (Daze, Mage Hand). Once per round, add your Charisma modifier (+2) to a cantrip's damage when it hits or the target fails its save.
hook: Her first proper job for the Keepers, and the dark under a mountain feels like home.

name: Rook Halloway

weapons.name: Longbow
weapons.notes: Piercing. Running Shot: Advantage on your first bow attack of the turn after moving 10ft. Fire Arrow: +1d6 fire. No Disadvantage shooting into a melee (Steady Aim), but Disadvantage if an enemy is within 5ft of you.

personality: A young woman in a red hood with a longbow nearly as tall as she is, and a habit of climbing anything that gives a good view. Bright, eager and stubborn; she counts her arrows twice and her blessings once. She learned volley drill on the walls of Fort Dunwell and grew up on the war stories of her uncle Marten Halloway, a veteran she is determined to impress.
inAFight: Move at least 10ft, then shoot for Advantage on your first arrow; Steady Aim lets you shoot into a melee without penalty. Save Fire Arrows for spilled oil, rope bridges and anything that matters.
abilitiesText:
**Running Shot.** If you moved at least 10ft this turn before attacking with a bow, Advantage on your first bow attack that turn. Standing still gives nothing.

**Arrow Repertoire: Fire and Rope.** Fire Arrow: +1d6 fire on a hit, and it can set flammable things alight. Rope Arrow: trails a thin line up to 60ft and anchors on a solid hit; it can be climbed. Craft up to 4 special arrows a day (Dex +3, level 1) when you have materials, and carry no more than 4. You start with 3 Fire and 1 Rope.

**Bent Path.** Your first shot each round ignores the Disadvantage from Half Cover and reduces a shield's AC bonus by 2. Full Cover still blocks it.

**Fletcher's Craft (Intelligence).** Repair or craft bows, strings and arrows from what is to hand, and identify odd or trapped arrows.

**Volley Timing (kit).** Your first bow attack each round has Advantage against a creature an ally hit with a ranged attack since your last turn.

**Sentry's Patience (kit).** Advantage on Perception checks on watch or sentry duty.

**Human.** Speed 30ft, no darkvision. Knack: Spotting, with Advantage on Wisdom checks to notice things (not an NWP slot). Trained in two martial weapons of your choice (longsword and spear, not carried).

**Steady Aim (1st, Specialist).** No Disadvantage on ranged attacks against a target in melee with an ally.

**Perceptive Grit (1st, General, Human bonus feat).** +1 Wisdom (included). Advantage on Perception checks to avoid being surprised or ambushed.
hook: Uncle Marten will hear how tonight went, so it had better go well.
